method: Human visual review with view_image of all four contact sheets, plus full page views for the detail_pages. PDF and preview modification times verified.
findings: Fixed body-left / notes-right layout is consistent; each page contains 1–3 visible notes.
Wide tables use the full width only below the note area and do not collide with notes.
Diagrams preserve aspect ratio, their labels remain legible in full page views, and no text is cut.
Final page contains the answer section with substantial content; no isolated blank or orphan final page.
